legend.marineHeat.mhwNote: 0.25° grid, monthly mean SST anomaly, classified after Hobday et al. 2018; extent 115–126°E, 18–28°N (Taiping Island not covered); land is not drawn. Change year and month in the settings panel. Source: Ocean Data Bank, National Science and Technology Council, Taiwan (doi:10.5281/zenodo.7512112)
legend.marineHeat.crwMaskNote: Drawn only within NOAA reef monitoring areas (reef cells plus about 20 km), not the reefs themselves; Kinmen, Matsu and Taiping Island are not covered.
legend.marineHeat.crwNote: Satellite heat stress; it does not mean corals on site are necessarily bleached. From 2003; 1985–2002 is not included because of licensing limits. Source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch v3.1 monthly composites (5 km)
